process.title: Discovery
process.text: Conversations with your team, a look at your audience and an honest read on competitors.

process.title: Positioning and messaging
process.text: A clear point of view on who you are for and what you say.

process.title: Identity design
process.text: Visual identity built to express the strategy, not just look current.

process.title: Rollout
process.text: Guidelines, templates and launch support across your channels.

faq.q: Do we need a full rebrand?
faq.a: Not always. Often clearer messaging does more than a new logo. We will tell you honestly which one you need.

faq.q: What do we get at the end?
faq.a: A brand guide covering positioning, messaging, voice, logo usage, color and typography, plus the source files.

faq.q: How long does a brand project take?
faq.a: It depends on scope. A messaging refresh moves faster than a full identity. You get a clear timeline before we start.

faq.q: How involved do we need to be?
faq.a: Focused, but not overwhelming. We need your input on goals and feedback at key points. We handle research, writing and design.

faq.q: What if we're not a fit?
faq.a: We will say so early. Good brand work depends on alignment, and we would rather be honest than force it.
